# Joel Martinez — push to main

> GTM engineer in Seattle. I help CEOs and revenue leaders (CROs, VPs of Sales and Marketing) model the market, segment it, and test their hypotheses in days, not quarters — then build the data and AI systems that keep it running. Ten years carrying a bag; builds with AI. Available for project, fractional, or embedded work.

## How I help revenue leaders

1. **Map the market** — TAM modeling and segmentation from real signals (funding, hiring, tech stack, leadership changes).
2. **Test the hypothesis** — lists, messaging, and channels run as experiments, answered in weeks.
3. **Unblock the team** — lists sales ops can't deliver, call prep, personalization, ABM accounts for marketing, CRM sync, routing.

Cold email is the smallest part of it. Work shipped in SaaS, healthcare, hardware, mineral rights, and M&A.
